testChange.reason: Removed the checkpoint-interleaving test: it hooked the `copy` dep to fire a checkpoint between two file copies, and this task deletes that dep along with the copy mechanism, so the test can no longer express its intent. It was never a discriminating test anyway — it passed against both copy orderings. The invariant it aimed at is now structural: one engine operation cannot observe a torn state. Also dropped the now-meaningless `expect(deps.copy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` assertions.
